Fans shared his philosophy on building trust, sideline photos with stars like Troy Polamalu, and praised his humility as tributes highlighted his lasting legacy in Steelers Nation.

news.summary: NFL reporter Tom Pelissero reports optimism that Packers edge rusher Micah Parsons could return from his knee injury as early as Week 5 on Oct. 11 versus the Chicago Bears, or Week 6 against the Dallas Cowboys. news.hook: Jihad Ward is back with the Minnesota Vikings, bringing the energy and edge rush presence fans remember from 2024.
news.name: Vikings Reunite with Veteran Pass Rusher Jihad Ward on Practice Squad
news.summary: The Vikings signed 32-year-old outside linebacker Jihad Ward to their practice squad on Wednesday, filling it to capacity with 16 players. Ward returns after starting 12 games for the Titans last year with five sacks, and he was a key rotational piece in Minnesota's 2024 season who helped keep the locker room light. Observers like beat writer Alec Lewis praise the move for adding veteran depth and a familiar face behind the edge rushers, with fans calling him a strong addition for interior pressure.

news.hook: Yahoo Sports staff picks lit up the NFC East grid, with the Cowboys logo dominating seven out of eight spots. That near-unanimous nod has fans and analysts buzzing with doubt.
news.name: Yahoo Sports Staff Heavily Favors Cowboys in NFC East Predictions
news.summary: In Yahoo Sports' 2026 NFL season predictions, most staffers tabbed the Dallas Cowboys to win the NFC East, citing offseason additions and offensive continuity after their 7-9-1 finish last year. Skeptics in replies highlighted weak wins from 2025 and defensive questions, while some like Gregg Rosenthal called the picks 'crazy' given the Eagles' strong roster. Others noted Cowboys fans deserve a break from preseason hype, with CBS Sports showing a closer split at eight Cowboys votes to six for Philadelphia.

news.hook: Preseason buzz has the Dallas Cowboys pegged for an NFC East crown, but fans and memes are already pouring cold water on the optimism.
news.name: Cowboys Lead NFC East Predictions Amid Hype and Memes
news.summary: Analysts from Yahoo Sports and others forecast a strong season for the Cowboys, citing offensive strength, defensive upgrades, and projections like 9.2 wins and a 33.9% shot at the division title. After a 7-9-1 finish in 2025, the hype draws memes labeling them 'eliminated from playoff contention' early and comparisons to perennial hopefuls like the Patriots. Skeptics like Gregg Rosenthal call the favoritism overblown, especially against the Eagles, while fans split between embracing the excitement and expecting the usual cycle.

news.hook: Dozens of players stride toward the Lombardi Trophy in striking promo images for Super Bowl LXI at SoFi Stadium. The road to Los Angeles begins tonight with a rare Wednesday opener.
news.name: NFL Season Kicks Off Wednesday with Seahawks-Patriots Rematch
news.summary: The 2026 NFL regular season starts on Wednesday, September 9, when the defending champion Seattle Seahawks host the New England Patriots in a Super Bowl LX rematch at Lumen Field, airing at 8:20 p.m. ET on NBC and Peacock. This unusual timing follows the league's first regular-season game in Australia between the Rams and 49ers the next night. Fans buzz with excitement over promo art featuring players like Sam Darnold, Drake Maye, Trevor Lawrence, and Dak Prescott, while some joke about the league's 'script' as all 32 teams chase the February showdown in Los Angeles.

news.name: NFL Regular Season Kicks Off with Seahawks-Patriots Rematch
news.summary: The 2026 NFL regular season begins Wednesday, September 9, with Seattle hosting New England at Lumen Field, marking the start of the journey to Super Bowl LXI on February 14, 2027, at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood, California. Fans and analysts are sharing bold predictions, from Kay Adams picking a Bears-Broncos final to Bill Simmons forecasting a Seattle repeat over Detroit. An ESPN survey of executives has Joe Burrow as MVP favorite, Jahmyr Gibbs for Offensive Player of the Year, and Will Anderson Jr. leading Defensive Player nods, while early odds favor teams like the Rams and Bills in a wide-open race.

news.hook: Micah Parsons tore his ACL last December, but now there's real hope he's back terrorizing quarterbacks soon—maybe even against the Bears at home.
news.name: Packers Hope Micah Parsons Returns for Week 5 Bears Game
news.summary: NFL reporter Tom Pelissero reports optimism that Packers edge rusher Micah Parsons could return from his knee injury as early as Week 5 on Oct. 11 versus the Chicago Bears, or Week 6 against the Dallas Cowboys. Traded from the Cowboys before last season, Parsons suffered the torn ACL and meniscus damage in a Dec. 29, 2025, game and must miss the first four games. GM Brian Gutekunst expects him close after that window, though Parsons insists on feeling 100 percent first, prioritizing playoffs over rushing back.
